description: A cross-platform application to organise your collection of old programs for DOSBox.
##: The release asset is a Tauri NSIS installer, not a portable exe. Without the #/dl.7z fragment Scoop copies the setup exe into the app dir verbatim, so 'retrium.exe' never exists and shim creation fails with 'File doesn't exist'.

7-Zip unpacks the NSIS payload with 'retrium.exe' already at the archive root; no second-stage archive needs expanding, so installer leftovers are removed in post_install after shims and shortcuts exist.
autoupdate.hash is omitted: the GitHub release asset publishes a sha256 digest, so Github Mode supplies the hash without re-downloading the installer.
